en.text:
3 kills within 3? seconds of each spawns a Lightning Strike centered on the last target defeated, followed by a Lightning Storm.

Lightning Strike deals <pve 382 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 7 meter radius after 1.1 seconds, which falls to 0% damage at the edge of its radius.

Lighting Storm occurs 0.5 seconds after the Lightning Strike and releases 4 bolts spread in an X-Pattern over the target, dealing <pve 426 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 5 meter radius. Damage falls to 25% at the edge of the radius.
